newsitem.title: FRANCE: Donors pledge $750 million to Uganda in fiscal '97.
newsitem.headline: Donors pledge $750 million to Uganda in fiscal '97.

text.p: Donor nations pledged about $750 million in aid to Uganda for the 1997 tax year, roughly the same amount as the preceding year, but expressed worries about plans for increased defence spending, the World Bank said on Friday.
The Bank said this would include $475 million of project and technical assistance and $275 million in programme support, including $50 million for debt financing.

"The meeting congratulated Uganda on the adoption of its new constitution...the government was encouraged to continue to develop the democratic process through next year's local elections and beyond," the Bank said in a statement.

But donors voiced concern about continuing conflict in the North and West Nile regions and urged the government to seek a quick resolution. The World Bank affiliate nations also said they were worried about the increase in defence spending in the 1996-97 budget.
